script:
[Console]::OutputEncoding=[Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$p=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'EasyCV-Downloads-20261102-Chrome\googlechromestandaloneenterprise_arm64.msi'
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p){throw 'MSI already exists'}
$u='https://dl.google.com/dl/chrome/install/googlechromestandaloneenterprise_arm64.msi'
& curl.exe --fail --silent --show-error --location --max-time 40 --output $p $u
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'Official MSI download failed'}
$s=Get-AuthenticodeSignature -LiteralPath $p
@{url=$u;bytes=(Get-Item $p).Length;sha256=(Get-FileHash $p -Algorithm SHA256).Hash;signatureStatus=[string]$s.Status;publisher=$s.SignerCertificate.Subject;executed=$false}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
